follow-up time: The length of the hospital stay was measured.
outcome: Time to first audible intestinal sounds
Time to resume regular oral diet
cohort: 171 pregnant women undergoing term elective cesarean delivery.
finding: Rectal administration of 400 mcg misoprostol was associated with significantly faster recovery of bowel function and shorter post-cesarean delivery hospital stay compared to 200 mcg rectal misoprostol or traditional feeding regimens.
